label: preparing
what: Builder and innkeeper are organizing a surprise communal feast or gathering in the town hall at eighteen, with lantern lighting and reportedly two hundred fresh loaves. They deliberately withhold the occasion's details from the mayor; the innkeeper will escort the mayor. Neighbour knowingly helps spread invitations while preserving the surprise. Baker's involvement in supplying the feast is plausible but not established; secretary has observed and recorded preparations but is not confirmed as an organizer.
